name: @activepieces/piece-insighto-ai
description: AI-powered platform for capturing forms, conversations, and data sources with automated processing and outbound communications

add_text_blob.name: add_text_blob
add_text_blob.displayName: Add Text Blob Into Data Source
add_text_blob.description: Inserts a large text blob into an existing data source

datasource_id.description: Select the data source to add the text blob to

name.description: Optional name for this text blob entry

description.description: Optional description of what this text blob contains

text_content.description: The text content to add to the data source

aiMetadata.description: Appends a block of raw text content to an existing Insighto.ai data source, identified by its data source ID. Use this to feed knowledge-base material into a data source an assistant can draw from. Not idempotent: each call adds a new text blob entry, so repeating it duplicates the content.

upsert_contact.name: upsert_contact
upsert_contact.description: Create or update a contact using email or phone number

aiMetadata.description: Creates or updates an Insighto.ai contact, matching on the supplied email or phone number. Use when you need a contact to exist before referencing it elsewhere without checking first. At least one of email or phone number is required. Idempotent: the contact is keyed on email/phone, so repeating with the same input converges to the same record rather than creating duplicates.

make_outbound_call.name: make_outbound_call
make_outbound_call.description: Initiate an outbound call to a phone number using a configured widget

widget_id.description: Widget connected to Twilio, Plivo, or Telnyx for making calls

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound phone call to a destination number (E.164 format) through an Insighto.ai widget wired to a telephony provider such as Twilio, Plivo, or Telnyx. Optionally injects dynamic variables into the call prompt. Use when an agent should trigger a real voice call. Not idempotent: each call dials the recipient again.

create_campaign.name: create_campaign
create_campaign.description: Create a new outbound call campaign

interval.description: Time between executions (e.g., 60 for hourly, 1440 for daily)

widget_id.description: Widget to associate with this campaign

attributes.description: Additional campaign attributes as key-value pairs

execution_weekdays.description: Weekdays as numbers (e.g., [1, 2, 3] for Mon, Tue, Wed)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new scheduled outbound-call campaign in Insighto.ai, configured with a start time, repeat interval, and optional widget, weekday/time-window scheduling, status, and time zone. Use when an agent should set up an automated calling campaign. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate campaign.

new_captured_form.name: new_captured_form
new_captured_form.description: Fires when a new form submission is captured in Insighto.ai

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an Insighto.ai assistant captures a new form submission during a conversation, delivering the submitted field values along with the originating form, conversation, widget, and assistant IDs.

new_conversation.name: new_conversation
new_conversation.description: Fires when an existing conversation is updated with a new message

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an Insighto.ai conversation is updated with a new message, delivering the full conversation transcript along with the contact, widget, and assistant IDs.

transcript.text: Hello, I need help with my order
I'd be happy to help you with your order. Could you please provide your order number?

new_contact.name: new_contact
new_contact.description: Triggers when a new contact is created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new contact appears in the Insighto.ai account. Polls the contact list on a schedule and emits each contact it has not seen before.
